description: Publishes the trained model as a model card to the PATRA knowledge base.

short_description.description: One or two sentence summary shown on cards and search results

full_description.description: Full write-up shown on the model detail page

keywords.description: Comma-separated terms e.g. classification, plant disease

category.description: Task or domain e.g. classification, segmentation, detection

input_type.description: Kind of data the model expects e.g. image, text

framework.description: ML framework e.g. PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers

model_location.description: URL to download the trained model weights e.g. HuggingFace Hub URL

is_private.description: Private records are restricted to your organization

tapis_token.description: Tapis JWT token for PATRA authentication
